item.title: Engineers create balloon telescope to study exoplanet atmospheres
item.description: Engineers and astronomers have unveiled a groundbreaking telescope design for studying exoplanet atmospheres, offering near-space observations at a fraction of the cost of orbital missions, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Romania leads Europe in next-generation nuclear energy
item.description: Romania is emerging as a leader among developing European countries in the field of next-generation nuclear energy. The centerpiece of this effort is the construction of a nuclear power plant in Deutschești, based on innovative small modular reactors (SMRs), AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Armenia’s constitution: A fault line in peace process - Lessons from Munich
item.description: The peace process is no longer measured by diplomatic formulas but by internal political resilience. The failure to sign the agreed peace text between Azerbaijan and Armenia is not due to technical details but to a fundamental question that Yerevan’s political system has been unable to resolve: on what reality is the state’s constitutional identity based?

item.title: Kazakhstan to build CIS’s first green fuel plant
item.description: Kazakhstan is set to become a regional leader in sustainable energy with the construction of a new plant for the production of environmentally friendly automotive and aviation fuels, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: MAMA “Mother Nature” international art exhibition opens in Tirana
item.description: The MAMA “Mother Nature” International Art Exhibition has opened at the residence of the Prime Minister of Albania in Tirana, bringing together artists from different countries in a celebration of art and environmental awareness.

item.title: Baku hosts C6 international conference on strategic regional dialogue
item.description: An international conference titled “C6: One Region, One Shared Future – Strengthening Strategic Dialogue” is being held in Baku, organized by the Center of Analysis of International Relations (CAIR), AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Farid Shafiyev: Central Asia is Azerbaijan’s natural strategic partner
item.description: Central Asia is not merely a neighbor for Azerbaijan, but a natural partner, AzerNEWS reports, citing Farid Shafiyev, Chairman of the Board of the Center of Analysis of International Relations, as he said at the international conference titled “C6: One Region, One Shared Future – Strengthening Strategic Dialogue.”

item.title: Central Azeri delivers 157 million tons of oil since launch
item.description: A total of 157 million tons of oil have been produced from the platform since it was commissioned, AzerNEWS reports, citing the Azerbaijan’s Energy Ministry.

item.title: EBRD: Azerbaijan strengthens fiscal discipline in natural resource management
item.description: Azerbaijan has succeeded in strengthening fiscal discipline in the management of its natural resources, AzerNEWS reports, citing the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD).

item.title: Leyla Aliyeva meets with Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama in Tirana
item.description: Leyla Aliyeva is on a visit to the Republic of Albania, AzerNEWS reports.
